messages.text:
Validation exposed two concrete faults: a reserved SQL alias and a TanStack Start entry API mismatch with the installed version.

I’m fixing those exact boundaries instead of changing the app shape, because the desired end state is still the same: Start must own routing/SSR and SQL must own the business math.
